about: Files this project has stopped shipping. `lab/update_tribe.py` names every entry that is still on an owner's disk and deletes it only when the owner passes --prune. A retired file is a decision with a reason and a date, never a side effect of an update.

files.why: A Google Apps Script timer that pressed Run workflow outside GitHub's scheduler. It worked — installed on the founder's circle, 204 accepted, run green — and was ruled out of the product the same day: a second account, a long-lived token stored off the repository, and a third-party page that changes under a manual. The measurement it was built for is printed on Today instead, beside the wake a person asks for. Nothing depends on this file; a circle that keeps it can ignore it or run --prune.
